name: mcp-memori
description: MCP Memory Server v8.9.2 — File-based .md Runbooks + Hybrid Search (FTS5+Vector+RRF) + 5 Lifecycle Hooks + Overlap Detection + 3-Layer Dedup + Hard-block + Contradiction Detection + Per-session Isolation

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Cari runbook — hybrid search (FTS5 BM25 + Vector + RRF merge + domain reranking + credential-priority snippets). Returns structured results with id, title, score, snippet, next_call.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Baca isi runbook. Support pagination (offset/limit), section filter, search param untuk entry lookup, sections_list navigasi, line/line_count. Unlocks hard-block.

tools.name: memory_upsert
tools.description: Simpan atau update runbook (.md file). Section-aware append, hard-block enforce, 3-layer dedup, overlap detection, fuzzy replace_entry, memory_type auto-routing (11 types), contradiction detect.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Hapus teks/section/file dari runbook. WAJIB memory_get(id) dulu sebelum forget. Support dry_run preview, occurrence guard, remove_all.

tools.name: memory_verify
tools.description: Read-only pre-write check: duplicate, near-duplicate, contradiction, staleness detection. Deterministic RUNBOOK-first target resolution. Tidak menulis file.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Statistik runbook files: total, size, tags breakdown, verified/success/fail counts.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: Browse semua runbook files. Supports pagination, tag/title filtering.

tools.name: memory_autolog
tools.description: Internal tool: auto-append hook-captured events to ## _AUTO_LOG section. Bypasses hard-block (append-only log). ## headers sanitized before write. NOT for manual use — use memory_upsert instead.

tools.name: memory_timeline
tools.description: Lihat konteks kronologis di sekitar suatu event. Tampilkan N entries sebelum/sesudah anchor (observation ID atau timestamp). Berguna untuk memahami apa yang terjadi sebelum/sesudah suatu aksi.
